name: ags-hyprland-shell
description: AGS v2 (Astal) desktop shell for Hyprland on Fedora

comments.astal: The 'astal' JS glue is NOT on npm (the name is squatted). AGS vendors it at runtime; for editor typechecking run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/aylur/astal /tmp/astal && cp -r /tmp/astal/lang/gjs ./vendor/astal && npm i --no-save ./vendor/astal
